subject: QBR prep: Stratus Cloud – customer snapshot & exec ask tracker
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: QBR prep: Stratus Cloud - initial snapshot and asks

Team —

We have Stratus Cloud's QBR scheduled for the week of Nov 29. I want a concise customer health snapshot and a one-page executive ask list for the board-level briefing. Please consolidate into a single slide + one-line risk register entry per item.

Key pieces I need by end of day Tuesday (11/17):
- Current renewal status and projected seat/license growth for FY27
- Top 3 operational risks (latency incidents, billing disputes, compliance questions) with severity and owner
- Any outstanding procurement/contract blockers and timing
- One customer quote or usage stat that speaks to value delivered

Laura — can you own the risk register and attach evidence (incident report IDs)? Marissa — can you draft the executive ask slide? Jonas — confirm any infra SLO misses in the last 90 days.

Thanks — keep this tight. We'll iterate on Wed.

— Michael
Michael Grant
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: michael.grant@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-17T11:09:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Stratus Cloud - initial snapshot and asks

Michael — attaching the first-pass risk register (see attachment). Highlights below:

1) Renewal timing / commercial risk:
- Renewal window: Feb 2027; current committed spend $420k ARR; expansion target $125k ARR if we meet reliability SLA on backbone queries.
- Risk: NPV risk if pricing/discount negotiations slip into Jan. Owner: Marissa.

2) Performance incidents (operational):
- Two P1 incidents in last 90 days tied to unexpected model warmup; last incident: INC-2026-1092 (2026-09-28) – 12m user impact; mitigated via auto-warm policy. Severity: Medium-High. Owner: Jonas.

3) Procurement & contract redlines:
- Procurement has redlined data residency clause; Stratus requests SOC2 appendix and KMS attestation. Procurement contact: procurement@stratuscloud.com. Owner: laura.bennett.

4) Billing discrepancy:
- Dispute over 2026-08 token overages (~$8.6k). Finance has requested usage logs; awaiting reply from Stratus (Ben Kline). Owner: Marissa.

Evidence attached: incident summaries, billing extract, latest SOC2 status note. I flagged two items that I believe require executive attention on the QBR slide: procurement/residency ask and the renewal timing (negotiation runway).

Attachment: 20261117-stratus-risk-register-v1.xlsx

Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Carolyn Diaz <carolyn.diaz@stratuscloud.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, michael.grant@redwood.ai
Cc: Ben Kline <ben.k@stratuscloud.com>, procurement@stratuscloud.com
Date: 2026-11-18T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Stratus Cloud - initial snapshot and asks

Thanks, Laura and team. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Residency / SOC2: procurement confirms they need a bounded SOC2 attestation and a KMS workflow diagram showing customer key separation. We can move fast if you share the appendix by EOW (Nov 21).
- Billing: Ben is pulling the August logs today and will upload to the secure SFTP link you shared.
- Renewal: We're on track to start negotiation in mid-Jan; our budget cycle closes Dec 20, so an early exec alignment call in early Jan would be ideal.

Also — are you able to quantify the customer impact from the September incident? We need language for our internal ops review.

Best,
Carolyn
Carolyn Diaz
Director, Platform Engineering — Stratus Cloud
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: michael.grant@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Stratus Cloud - initial snapshot and asks

Folks — I pulled the slide deck draft (attached) and turned Laura's risk points into an "Exec Attention" two-column table. Summary:

- Exec asks (what we want from Redwood execs):
  * Approve 30% concession buffer for early renewal if we get legal appendix signed by Dec 10
  * Prioritize a one-week engineering deep-dive with Stratus (post-QBR) to shore up warmup timings
  * Authorize a one-time credit ($6k) against the August overage to close the billing dispute quickly

- Proposed owners & timing:
  * Commercial / discounting: Marissa — deliver proposal by 2026-12-08
  * Legal/KMS appendix: Laura — provide draft by 2026-11-21 (Carolyn requested EOW)
  * Incident remediation: Jonas — present root cause and mitigation plan during QBR

Attachment: 20261120-qbr-slide-deck-draft.pdf

Please review the asks and call out anything that needs to be softened before I escalate to Exec.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Commercial Lead, North America — Redwood Inference
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: ceo@redwood.ai, finance-leads@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-21T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: Stratus Cloud - exec attention items (finalized)

Thanks all — good work. I'm finalizing the one-pager for the executive review; key executive attention items (final):

1) Procurement / Compliance ask
- Action: Legal to sign off on SOC2 appendix + KMS attestation draft by 11/21 end-of-day to keep procurement on schedule. Owner: Laura.

2) Commercial concession authority
- Action: Approve up to 30% short-term concession for early renewal closure. Owner: Marissa to prepare paper for CFO.

3) Incident remediation commitment
- Action: Jonas to present RCA and a 60-day remediation plan in the QBR; engineering to allocate a two-week prioritization window post-QBR.

4) Billing resolution
- Action: Approve one-time credit of up to $6,000 pending verification of August usage logs. Owner: Finance.

Next steps: Marissa, please send the exec-facing slide + the one-pager to the exec list by COB today. Laura, confirm SOC2 appendix delivery (or escalate if blocked). Jonas, prepare the RCA slides and schedule a 30m dry-run with me on Nov 24.

I'll include the two attachments in the board packet. If anyone sees a blocker that prevents these timelines, call it out now.

— Michael
Michael Grant
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
